response.sql:
WITH per_source AS (
  SELECT p.fundflux,
         AVG((s.boxy - s.boxx) / s.boxx) AS avg_y_vs_x_difference,
         AVG(s.aream2 / s.volm3) AS area_to_volume_ratio
  FROM projects AS p
  JOIN scanspatial AS s ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
), eligible AS (
  SELECT fundflux, avg_y_vs_x_difference, area_to_volume_ratio
  FROM per_source
  WHERE area_to_volume_ratio IS NOT NULL
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(area_to_volume_ratio) AS simple_average_ratio
  FROM eligible
)
SELECT e.fundflux,
       e.avg_y_vs_x_difference,
       e.area_to_volume_ratio,
       e.area_to_volume_ratio - o.simple_average_ratio AS above_average_by
FROM eligible AS e
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE e.area_to_volume_ratio > o.simple_average_ratio;

assumptions.assumption: The area-to-volume ratio for each funding source is the average of each matching record's aream2 / volm3, and the comparison baseline is the unweighted average of those per-source ratios. NULL inputs are ignored by AVG; division by zero yields NULL in PostgreSQL and is ignored.
